tools.name: verify_mcp_endpoint
tools.description: Free, no API key. Read-only verification of a public MCP HTTPS endpoint or official Registry server name. Checks DNS/SSRF safety, TLS/HTTP reachability, initialize, tools/list schema sanity, latency and discovery metadata. Never invokes remote tools or forwards credentials.

tools.name: oxibay_doctor
tools.description: Free, no API key. Read-only MCP diagnostic. Reuses MYCELIX endpoint verification, classifies technical failures, and optionally compares the requested capability with declared tool metadata. Never invokes remote tools, never forwards credentials, and never affects commercial gates.
